bm_wp_wpn_fps_ass_amcar_body_ddm4_desc: Is it really a DDCAR4 without that handguard and stock?
bm_wp_wpn_fps_ass_galil_body_intermediat: A lighter version of the Gecko 7.62 more suited for infantry roles. It appears that someone got lazy with the markings.
bm_wp_wpn_fps_ass_m4_body_tantone_desc: Chains had to make do with a MAR-7 lower after he couldn't find a matching tan receiver.
bm_wp_wpn_fps_ass_g3_body_hk33_desc: The SG-33, best described as, ''the forgotten middle child of Schäfer & Gewehr,'' is SG's 5.56 NATO offering based on the Gewehr-3. It serves a good balance of the Compact-5 rate of fire with the Gewehr-3 range and accuracy.
bm_wp_wpn_fps_smg_shepheard_body_ar45_de: A pistol calibre carbine converted into a submachine gun. Nothing too special about it aside from the fact it fires .45 ACP.
bm_wp_wpn_fps_smg_x_shepheard_body_ar45_: What's better than one AR-15 in .45 ACP? Two of them! Be prepared for a good amount of recoil though.
bm_wp_wpn_fps_ass_ak_body_creedmoor_desc: Converts your AK pattern rifle to fire 6.5 Creedmoor. Reduces ammo capacity and pickup in exchange for big damage and enemy, armor, and wall piercing capabilities. If you want shield piercing, that's what sniper rifles are for.
bm_wp_wpn_fps_ass_ak_body_creedmoor_sc_d: It's not every day you find an actual battle rifle in the AK platform. Uses highly accurate 6.5 Creedmoor rounds to get results.
bm_wp_wpn_fps_ass_m16_body_mcbravo_desc: A CAR clone in 300 Blackout as a replacement for the Compact-5. The project was doomed from the start as the Compact-5 is too iconic to replace.
bm_wp_wpn_fps_smg_mac10_body_m4_v2_desc: Even after his magnum opus, the Frankensmith was not satisfied. He sought to try and improve upon perfection, as crazy as it sounds. He found a second Mark-10, another set of parts, and got to work once more...
bm_wp_wpn_fps_smg_olympic_body_hk416c_de: An actual SG-416C carbine with no strings attached to it.
bm_wp_wpn_fps_smg_olympic_body_hk416c_sc: If the original SG-416 is a refinement of the CAR-4, then the SG-416C is a refinement of the Para-23. It's a compact piston operated rifle specced to be a like a main weapon when your actual main arm runs dry.
bm_wp_wpn_fps_smg_x_olympic_body_hk416c_: While the Bootleger is enough to get the job done, having two of them even when they're using standard magazines is much more flashy.
bm_wp_wpn_fps_ass_g36_body_stanag_desc: Who's idea was it to give an already middling assault rifle proprietary mags?
bm_wp_wpn_fps_snp_victor_body_ar15_desc: Switches the North Star for a Crosskill-produced rifle. It also uses overpressurized 5.56mm... don't ask how it works.
bm_wp_wpn_fps_shot_m590_set_desc: Comes with a shell rack that doesn't do much.
bm_wp_wpn_fps_ass_scar_body_hamr_desc: A prototype weapon made by Acuto for the Military's Infantry Automatic Weapon program. Unfortunately for them, they were beat out by SG's offering of the AMR-27. Fortunately for you, Gage just so happened to get a hold of one of them. Comes with an alternate aiming mode.
bm_wp_wpn_fps_pis_x_1911_body_sporty_des: This ain't getting used my guy
bm_wp_wpn_fps_smg_akmsu_body_gold_desc: Why limit yourself to just one gaudy and golden AK?
bm_pdw_sc_paint_desc: #{skill_color}#Deals 75% of its damage through body armor.##
bm_wp_wpn_fps_ass_akm_body_tacticool_des: It's not the 40s anymore, so why not bring that thing up to modern standards?
bm_wp_wpn_fps_ass_s552_body_s550_desc: 5.6mm isn't really fit to be a sniper round, but maybe if it flies out of a long enough barrel it could do some serious damage.
bm_s552_body_s550_sc_desc:
An elegant alternative to other long-range 5.56mm rifles, once utilized by the Swiss Police. Uses special Swiss-made 5.6mm rounds that offer better range.

#{skill_color}#Can pierce body armor, multiple enemies, shields within max damage range and thin walls.##
bm_wp_wpn_fps_ass_m14_body_ac556_desc:
While the B-Team Stock is simply inspired by the rifles used by the A-Team, this is a genuine Simmons Armory BC-556, same stuff those soldiers of fortune used.

As it turns out, the rifle itself was why the A-Team kept missing so much.
bm_wp_wpn_fps_ass_m14_body_ac556_sc_desc:
While the B-Team Stock is simply inspired by the rifles used by the A-Team, this is a genuine Simmons Armory BC-556, same stuff those soldiers of fortune used.

As it turns out, the rifle itself was why the A-Team kept missing so much.

Adds a 3-round burst firemode.
bm_wp_wpn_fps_smg_shepheard_body_centi_d: Another offering from Bear Arms, this time it's a 10mm carbine using cutting edge radial-delayed blowback operation, resulting in a smoother shooting experience... well, smoother by 10mm standards.
bm_wp_wpn_fps_ass_contraband_body_little: A middle ground between Scarface's original Little Friend and the "Big Boy" he carries around now.
bm_m203_paintsets_sc_desc:
A middle ground between Scarface's original "Little Friend" AMR-16 and the "Big Boy" SG-417D he carries around now.

Holding #{skill_color}#$BTN_BIPOD## switches to the undermounted grenade launcher.
bm_m203_paintsets_sc_desc_pc:
A middle ground between Scarface's original "Little Friend" AMR-16 and the "Big Boy" SG-417D he carries around now.

Pressing #{skill_color}#$BTN_BIPOD## switches to the undermounted grenade launcher.
bm_wp_wpn_fps_smg_polymer_body_nine_desc: If .45 is that smooth shooting, then 9mm would basically be like having no recoil at all.
menu_l_global_value_paint_sets: This is an Conversion Kit Pack item!
